source:
At his best friend Satoya's suggestion, Hodaka decides to do a test of courage with him at the school.
But that marked the start of a tiny tragedy.

[Translated from the [url=http://winter.vivian.jp/mo/game/td/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
在摯友里谷的提議下，穗高決定和他一起在學校進行試膽。
然而，這標誌著一場微小悲劇的開始。
